ui_bugs.issue: Chat window starts visible instead of hidden. The 'hidden' class in className is being stripped by tailwind-merge in the cn() utility because it conflicts with 'flex'. User sees chat open on page load.

action_items: Fix chat window initial visibility: Use React state to control visibility instead of CSS class toggle, or use 'invisible' class instead of 'hidden' to avoid tailwind-merge conflict
